create_blur_transform: create a Blur transform class to apply Gaussian blur with configurable sigma to a video file
create_brightness_transform: create a Brightness transform class to brighten or darken a video by a specified level factor
create_randomblur_transform: create a RandomBlur transform class to randomly blur a video with sigma chosen from a min-max range
create_compose_transforms: create a composition of video transforms like Blur, Brightness, and HFlip to apply multiple augmentations in sequence
create_overlay_transform: create an Overlay transform class to overlay an image or video onto another video at a specified position
